diagnostic_explanation: The raw backbone ECE of 24.5% was caused by extreme underconfidence due to 198-class softmax dispersion and class-weighted training. Hard logit masking truncated the softmax denominator from 198 classes to ~5 classes, artificially inflating confidence without genuine calibration. When temperature scaling is properly fit on the validation split (T_raw = 0.6228), raw ECE drops to genuine calibrated levels. Furthermore, Soft Gating P(disease) = P(crop) * P(disease|crop) provides a rigorous, smooth probabilistic formulation.
